learning_salience.rationale: dominant coverage of gateway KPs kp_deep_learning_resurgence and kp_cs230_deep_learning_as_neural_network_based_machine_learning_in_the_cs_ml_dl_g; motivation segment contrasts scaling behavior of older ML vs neural networks and maps the CS -> ML -> DL -> GenAI stack.

dominant coverage of kp_cs230_choosing_between_prompting_and_direct_deep_learning_by_data_modality plus substantial coverage of kp_practical_fine_tuning_decision_flowchart; modality- and cost-based product decision heuristics support application items, but prerequisite/Q&A framing lowers salience.

dominant coverage of critical KP kp_cs230_disciplined_ml_project_diagnostics with substantial coverage of kp_cs230_hyperparameter_tuning_as_a_high_leverage_optimization_skill and kp_cs230_empirical_data_sufficiency_via_small_pilot_experiments; this is a heuristic-heavy diagnostic segment about what to change in a system and how to size data collection.

dominant coverage of optional KP kp_cs230_responsible_rapid_prototyping_with_ai_assisted_coding and substantial support from kp_cs230_cs_fundamentals_plus_ai_tool_fluency; useful sandboxing/prototyping heuristics are assessable, but this material is more workflow-oriented than course-core deep-learning content.

dominant coverage of kp_cs230_modern_genai_application_stack with substantial coverage of kp_cs230_cs_fundamentals_plus_ai_tool_fluency; there is some conceptual stack content, but the closing career/Q&A framing makes this less assessment-worthy than the earlier methodology units.
